title: Brennan Auto Care knowledge base
purpose: Front page for staff: what each folder holds, who owns it, and the two house rules (prices, corrections).
facts: Ten staff folders are listed with what they hold and who keeps them; office and management folders exist and are rank-limited.
Rule 1: prices are quoted from prices/price-list.md only; a price on a service page may be old.
Rule 2: lead advisors and above (middle rank) can propose a correction; slots 4, 22 and 2 publish; others tell their lead.
The website assistant reads customers/, shop-floor/, services/ and the price list (ledger s12.pages).
kb_overview reads this file as the README of the root for staff; it is hidden from the public reader (seen_from junior on the file).

rows.What is in it: Answers we give the public. The website assistant quotes these pages word for word, so they are written for customers. It also reads the service pages and the price list.
What each job is, when a car needs it, what to ask, what customers push back on.
The price list and the labour rates. The only place a price comes from.
Company accounts: terms, who may approve work, what each fleet expects.
How we do the counter jobs: a call, a booking, an estimate, handing a car back, the till.
Suppliers, ordering, returns, what we stock.
Each shop's own pages: hours, who is who, keys and alarms, local habits.
Who is who across the company, the staff handbook, first weeks for new people.
For technicians: clocking in, inspections, checks before a car leaves.

list_items.item: Quote from the price list. A price on a service page is there to explain the job. It may be old. The price list is never old, because it is the page I change when a price changes.

If a page is wrong, say so the same day. Lead advisors and above can propose a correction from the page itself; Greg, Dale or I publish it. Everybody else: tell your lead. How: Using and fixing this knowledge base.

new_facts: Folder owners: customers 2; services 5 and 16; prices 2; policies 2; accounts 4; how-to 4; parts 9; team 2; shop-floor 8 (designed, follows the cast biographies).
